text:
"foundation 0050: the causal payoff test — build the win model on path-inferred physiology only (hill critical-velocity anchor + hill reserve + field/draft deployment + physical mass), every meta-signal stripped, and test whether form re-emerges. verdict: form does not re-emerge at the win-prob level — the pure-physics model does not reproduce the form→result gradient (recovers only 7% st / 4% hv of the empirical form→win slope; non-monotone), and path-inferred ability predicts held-out form only weakly (hill v_c→held-out form ρ≈+0.07 st / +0.03 hv, well above the rating floor ≈+0.01/−0.02 but far below the trailing-form ceiling +0.38/+0.30). the gof falls to the floor: %market 65→−8 (st), 60→+5 (hv), paired fixed-seed — the honest baseline we rebuild from. path-fit: the hill-anchored field-coupled forward path under-resolves the tight per-cell descriptive baseline (rmse 1.38 vs 0.45 st). the directional win re-emergence of 0049 (collateral, ρ −0.02→+0.33) does not carry to the win-probability gradient — the path-inferred ability is real but too weak a discriminator to recover form without the win-calibrated gain (the 0039 under-discrimination, re-confirmed on the pure-mechanism model)." causal causal-rebuild payoff-test pure-mechanism form re-emergence reemergence form-reemergence hill critical-velocity deconfound field-coupling physiology strip meta-signal cause-not-effect gof-fall percent-of-market win-gradient form-gradient decisive-test path-fit leak-free strictly-prior first-principles no-regression stage-1 0037 0039 0048 0049 theta-builder pure-mechanism-theta-builder draft — the causal payoff test (causal_model.md §6, the form headline of §4.2/§4.3). new additive
module `src/hkjc/model/pure_mechanism.py` (the `puremechanismthetabuilder`) + `studies/causal_reemergence.py`
+ `tests/test_pure_mechanism.py`. the eom core (`dynamics.py`), `identify.py` (hill), `field.py`
(coupling), the production ability fit, and `data_cache` are imported untouched. no odds-gating; win%
is measured, never optimized. leak-free strictly-prior (assert_no_lookahead drift = 0, both venues).
(nb the causal-physics package was folded `hkjc.statespace`→`hkjc.model` 2026-06; paths reflect that.)

## the build — path-inferred physiology only, zero meta-signals
the `puremechanismthetabuilder` is the cause-not-effect contrast to `assembly.production_theta_builder`
(which stamps the meta-signal-fused production `v_c_eb`). each runner's drift is assembled from, in
strictly-prior source priority:
1. **hill critical velocity** (`identify.hill_fit` slope over the horse's prior distance–time points,
   ≥3 distinct distances) — the de-confounded aerobic cp anchor (0048/0049), not the pace-inflated
   per-race cruise. w′ = the **hill intercept** d′ [m] (anaerobic distance capacity, on the same
   distance-unit axis the generative `w′/l` boost reads).
2. else the horse's prior **de-confounded settled cruise** (`field.deconfounded_cruise_velocity`, the
   field/draft deployment read of 0049) — the coarser ability proxy for a horse with too few distinct
   distances for a hill line.
3. else the **rating-conditioned population mean** (fit train-only per fold) — the debut/thin-prior
   concession (the flagged t1; rating enters here only, never as a per-runner ability channel).
mass = declared weight (physical). env kept: draw, going→c_rr/surface, geometry, field size.
θ feeds `generative.py` (the byte-exact wald first-passage core) → win probs.

**confirmation zero meta-signals are used.** the module imports none of the meta-signal tables — no
form, recency-form, speed-figure, collateral, peak-gap, finishing-sectional, fade, barrier-trial,
gallop, jockey, trainer, trainer-hot, early-pos, gate-break. the builder deliberately leaves
`gate_break_shrunk`/`fig_disp` (stripped meta-signal geometry) off the conditions. a unit test
(`test_no_meta_signal_imports`) asserts no banned table name appears in the module's import lines; the
drift is hill-cp + field coupling + mass, full stop. coverage (of the path panel): st hill 8,395 /
de-confounded 15,663 of 24,433 runners; hv hill 1,665 / de-confounded 6,304 of 14,823.

## the headline — does form re-emerge? verdict: no (at the win-prob level)

### (a) ability → held-out form (the consequence arrow)
does path-inferred ability predict a horse's held-out realized relative-finish (the form signal),
vs the population floor (rating) and the trailing-form ceiling (form's own autocorrelation)?

| venue | path-ability v_c → held-out form | rating floor → held-out | trailing-form ceiling → held-out | v_c → trailing-form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** (n=15,663) | pearson **+0.066** (spearman +0.062) | +0.015 (+0.001) | **+0.382** (+0.373) | +0.123 |
| **hv** (n=6,304)  | pearson **+0.033** (spearman +0.029) | −0.022 (−0.022) | **+0.302** (+0.289) | +0.070 |

the path-inferred ability does carry held-out-form signal **above the rating floor** (+0.066 vs +0.015
st; +0.033 vs −0.022 hv) — the de-confounded hill ability is a real, leak-free ability read, not noise.
but it sits **far below the trailing-form ceiling** (+0.38/+0.30): a direct past-form measurement
predicts future form ~6–9× better than the path-inferred physiology does. the ability→form consequence
arrow is present but weak.

### (b) the decisive joint test — reproduce the form→result gradient without form
bin runners by their (held-out) recency-form; does the pure-physics win-prob track the realized
win-rate gradient across form bins as the form-fed production model does?

| | st empirical win | st pure-mech p | st production p | hv empirical | hv pure-mech | hv production |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| form-bin 0 (low) | 0.019 | 0.077 | 0.016 | 0.032 | 0.084 | 0.028 |
| form-bin 1 | 0.050 | 0.079 | 0.043 | 0.065 | 0.088 | 0.059 |
| form-bin 2 | 0.066 | 0.073 | 0.064 | 0.078 | 0.087 | 0.080 |
| form-bin 3 | 0.089 | 0.083 | 0.099 | 0.102 | 0.088 | 0.110 |
| form-bin 4 (high) | **0.175** | **0.088** | **0.177** | **0.159** | **0.090** | **0.159** |
| **form→win slope** | **+0.247** | **+0.017** (7%) | +0.262 (106%) | **+0.216** | **+0.009** (4%) | +0.231 (107%) |
| monotone | yes | **no** | yes | yes | **no** | yes |
| bin-level ρ(p,emp) | — | +0.78 | +0.996 | — | +0.86 | +0.996 |

**the pure-physics model does not reproduce the form→result gradient.** it recovers only **7% (st) /
4% (hv)** of the empirical form→win slope and is non-monotone; the form-fed production model recovers
~106%. the pure-mechanism win-prob is nearly flat across the form bins (st 0.077→0.088 vs the realized
0.019→0.175) — it cannot tell the top form-quintile from the bottom at the win-probability level, even
though its ability latent has the right sign (bin-level ρ +0.78/+0.86). **form does not re-emerge.**

## the gof-fall (measurement, not a gate) — the honest baseline
paired fixed-seed win gate, pure-mechanism vs production, both venues:

| venue | production %market (ece) | pure-mech %market (ece) | fall |
|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | **65.4%** (0.0068) | **−7.7%** (0.0227) | **−73.1pp** of market |
| **hv** | **60.0%** (0.0059) | **+4.7%** (0.0112) | **−55.3pp** of market |

the fall is to the floor (st −8% is below uniform; hv +5% is barely above). this is the expected /
accepted stage-1 fall (causal_model.md §5.3, t2 — recency-form alone is +7.8pp and the whole ability
stack is most of production's edge), measured honestly. ece roughly doubles–triples (the pure model is
less calibrated, as a flat-gradient model must be).

**decomposition — debut/thin vs the stripped ability stack** (mean −log p of the realized winner,
split by the winner's strictly-prior ability source):

| source | st n_wins | st pure-mech / production (δ) | hv n_wins | hv pure-mech / production (δ) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| hill-anchored winner | 676 | 2.808 / 2.221 (**+0.587**) | 123 | 2.689 / 2.163 (**+0.526**) |
| de-confounded-cruise winner | 608 | 2.027 / 2.116 (**−0.089**) | 437 | 2.193 / 2.231 (**−0.038**) |
| debut/population-fallback winner | 646 | 2.798 / 2.141 (**+0.657**) | 717 | 2.511 / 2.172 (**+0.339**) |

the fall is carried by both the debut concession (δ+0.66 st / +0.34 hv — no path to infer from, the
population mean is a poor discriminator) and the stripped ability stack (the hill-winner δ+0.59 st /
+0.53 hv — even where the physics has a clean hill anchor, it loses heavily to the meta-signal-fused
production ability). notably the de-confounded-cruise bin is ~neutral/slightly better than production
(δ−0.09 st) — the field-coupled cruise read (0049's re-emergence channel) is the one place the pure
physics is competitive, consistent with 0049's directional collateral re-emergence. but it is a minority
of winners and does not lift the aggregate.

## path-fit — the stage-0 bar (descriptive baseline)
field-coupled forward path from the hill anchor (literature-bounded w′_0/p_max + observed field pace)
vs a physics-free descriptive baseline (population mean velocity per (distance, section-index, n_sec)
cell — it never sees the individual horse). route runs ≥1400 m, hill-anchored, ~6k sections/venue:

| venue | field-coupled(hill) rmse (bias) | descriptive cell-mean rmse | bar |
|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | 1.38 m/s (+1.10) | **0.45** m/s | **fail** |
| **hv** | 1.10 m/s (+0.88) | **0.41** m/s | **fail** |

the hill-anchored forward path fails this descriptive bar — but read this honestly: (1) the descriptive
baseline here is the tight per-cell mean (the strongest physics-free predictor — 0044's "flexible
descriptive baseline" that the generator also trailed); (2) the forward path carries a +0.9–1.1 m/s
level over-prediction because it uses literature w′_0/p_max defaults (not the per-run nls inversion) on
the de-confounded lower hill anchor — exactly the 0049 isolated-baseline bias note (0049's isolated eom
also sat at +0.9 bias; its field coupling on the same physiology removed it). the pure-mechanism win
drift does not integrate the forward path (it reads the hill v_c directly into the wald law), so this
path-fit fail is a diagnostic on the forward generator's level bias at the hill anchor, not on the win
build's ability read. still: it does not clear the stage-0 adequacy bar as posed, and that is recorded.

## the verdict — form does not re-emerge; the path ability is real but too weak a discriminator
the decisive test fails: the pure-mechanism model, built on path-inferred physiology with every
meta-signal stripped, does not reproduce the form→result gradient (7%/4% of the slope, non-monotone)
and predicts held-out form only weakly (ρ≈+0.07/+0.03, above the rating floor but ~6–9× below the
trailing-form ceiling). the win% falls to the floor (65→−8 st, 60→+5 hv). this is the 0039 finding
re-confirmed on the causal model: the path identifies a real de-confounded ability (it beats the rating
floor; the de-confounded-cruise winners are ~neutral vs production), but the honestly-inferred hill
ability under-discriminates for win — it cannot do the order-statistic tail work the win-calibrated form
gain does. 0049's directional win-level re-emergence (collateral ρ −0.02→+0.33) is real but does not
carry to the win-probability gradient: a +0.33 held-out-ability correlation is not a steep-enough
discriminator to sort the form quintiles at the win-prob level.

this is a §4.4 pointer, not a defeat: form failing to re-emerge ⇒ **the path is not yet identifying the
full, tail-relevant ability** (needs the margins surface + the closing precision + the pace interaction
layer, causal_model.md stage 2). the fix is never to re-introduce the form gain — it is to enrich the
causal structure until the path-inferred ability is sharp enough to re-derive the gradient on its own.

## what re-emerges next / what's missing
- **the de-confounded-cruise channel is the live re-emergence** (δ−0.09/−0.04 vs production on its
  winners; 0049's +0.33 held-out persistence). it is the field-coupling deployment read — the collateral
  mechanism. form (the self-read) is weaker than collateral (the relational read) exactly as
  causal_model.md §4.4 predicted ("collateral re-emerges but form does not ⇒ the field-coupling is the
  missing piece"). build the field/pace interaction into the win drift (not just the path de-confound).
- **the hill anchor needs the w′/margins surface.** the hill intercept d′ is a coarse reserve; the
  forward path's +1.0 m/s level bias (literature w′_0/p_max on the de-confounded anchor) says the
  reserve/deployment is mis-scaled. stage 2's margins term (`likelihood.margin_term`) should sharpen
  w′ and lift the held-out-form correlation toward the ceiling.
- **debut/thin is a large, separable chunk of the fall** (δ+0.66 st / +0.34 hv) — a structural limit
  of physiology-only (no path to infer from), not a model error; the population-prior concession (t1).
- **path-fit generator level bias** at the de-confounded hill anchor (the +0.9–1.1 m/s) must close
  (the 0049 field-coupling removed it on the per-run physiology; wire that into the forward path used
  for the stage-0 bar) before the path-fit adequacy claim can be made.

## discipline
first-principles, no regression, no meta-signal features — the drift is hill-cp + field coupling +
mass. no odds-gating (win% measured, never optimized). leak-free: per-horse hill/de-confounded
physiology strictly-prior (a run's own path never enters its anchor — unit-tested); the population
prior fit train-only per fold; `assert_no_lookahead` drift = 0 both venues. production `hkjc.model` win
fit, `dynamics.py`/`identify.py`/`field.py` core, `data_cache` untouched (imported). new:
`pure_mechanism.py` + `studies/causal_reemergence.py` + 5-test unit suite (no-meta-signal-import guard;
source priority hill→decon→pop; stripped geometry off; drift clamp; strictly-prior hill leak-free).
lint clean; pure-mechanism + field + skeleton tests green (24). don't-bake — a research-model
measurement; no production constant changed. the gof fall is the honest baseline we rebuild from by
adding causal structure (the field/pace interaction + margins), not by re-feeding a stripped signal.

The decomposition shows the fall is the STRIPPED ABILITY STACK on raced horses (winner −log p: hill Δ+0.58 ST / +0.53 HV, debut Δ+0.66 / +0.34) far more than the debut concession. Strictly-prior, leak-free (drift 0), win% MEASURED not optimized."

(`studies/causal_reemergence.py`, 5 folds, n_samples=4000, both venues). the drift is hill-cp →

## (1) the gof fall — to the floor, both venues (measurement, not a gate)
% of market on the same pool-book gate the production model answers to (paired, same per-race seed):

| venue | production | pure-mechanism | fall | model ece | mkt ece | path coverage (hill / decon / debut) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | **65.4%** | **−7.6%** | **−73.0 pts** | 0.0238 | 0.0069 | 8,395 / 7,268 / 8,770 of 24,433 |
| **hv** | **60.0%** | **+4.6%** | **−55.4 pts** | 0.0116 | 0.0083 | 1,665 / 4,639 / 8,519 of 14,823 |

the fall is essentially to the uniform floor — at st the pure model is worse than 1/field on the
market gate (−7.6%; its win log-loss 2.558 > uniform 2.517). stripping the meta-signals removes
~100% of the model's market skill. this is the expected direction (0046 predicted "win% falls then
recovers fundamentally") but the magnitude is total: physiology-only does not discriminate winners
at the win gate.

**the split — it is the stripped ability stack on raced horses, not the debut concession.** mean
−log p on the realized winner, by the winner's ability source (lower = sharper on winners):

| winner source | st pure | st prod | st δ | hv pure | hv prod | hv δ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **hill** (has a hill line) | 2.807 | 2.226 | **+0.581** | 2.698 | 2.171 | **+0.527** |
| **decon** (de-conf. cruise) | 2.029 | 2.114 | **−0.085** | 2.189 | 2.226 | **−0.037** |
| **debut** (population mean) | 2.796 | 2.138 | **+0.658** | 2.512 | 2.174 | **+0.339** |

the hill-anchored raced horses are where the pure model loses most relative to production
(δ+0.58 st / +0.53 hv on their winners) — i.e. the loss is the stripped ability stack (form,
collateral, jockey, …), not merely the debut fallback. curiously the de-confounded-cruise group is
the only one the pure model wins on (δ−0.085 st / −0.037 hv) — the 0049 de-confounded level carries
a hair of real ability there — but it is swamped by the hill and debut groups. (the debut group's
large δ is the population mean having no per-runner discrimination at all — production still has
trial/gallop/rating for first-timers.)

## (2) the headline — does form re-emerge? **weakly in correlation, no at the win gate.**

**(2a) path-inferred ability (strictly-prior hill v_c) vs held-out recency-form.** pearson /
spearman of the path v_c against the run's realized relative-finish, vs the rating floor and the
trailing-form (autocorrelation) ceiling:

| venue | v_c → held-out form | rating floor | trailing-form ceiling | v_c → form-signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | **+0.066** / +0.062 | +0.015 / +0.001 | +0.382 / +0.373 | +0.123 |
| **hv** | **+0.033** / +0.029 | −0.022 / −0.022 | +0.302 / +0.289 | +0.070 |

the path ability is weakly but consistently above the population/rating floor (it beats rating
~4× at st, and rating is ~null) — so the hill anchor carries some genuine, de-confounded ability
that rating does not. but it is an order of magnitude below the trailing-form ceiling (+0.066 vs
+0.382). the arrow it should produce (v_c → the form signal itself) is +0.123 st / +0.070 hv — real
but faint. **nb this is weaker than the de-confounded-level re-emergence 0049 reported (+0.33 st /
+0.40 hv).** the difference is the population: 0049 measured the de-confounded settled-cruise on
route runs split in time within a horse; here `vc_hill` is the across-distance hill slope pooled
strictly-prior over all the horse's earlier races (often ≤3 distinct distances → a thin, noisy
slope). the de-confounded level is a better ability read than the hill slope at this data width.

**(2b) the decisive test — does the physics-only win prob reproduce the form→result gradient
without form?** bin runners by held-out recency-form (quintiles); mean model win-prob vs realized
win-rate across bins:

st — empirical win% rises 0.019 → 0.050 → 0.066 → 0.089 → **0.175** across form quintiles
(slope +0.247, monotone). pure-mech win% is **flat** (0.077 → 0.079 → 0.073 → 0.083 → 0.088;
slope +0.0166, non-monotone) — **recovers 7% of the empirical gradient**. production (form fed)
recovers 106% (slope +0.261, monotone). hv is the same shape: empirical slope +0.216, pure +0.0093
(**4%**, non-monotone), production +0.231 (107%).

| venue | empirical slope | pure-mech (recovers) | production (recovers) | bin-corr pure / prod |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | +0.247 | +0.0166 (**7%**, non-mono) | +0.261 (106%) | +0.782 / +0.996 |
| **hv** | +0.216 | +0.0093 (**4%**, non-mono) | +0.231 (107%) | +0.856 / +0.996 |

**⇒ form does not re-emerge at the win gate.** the physics-only win prob is nearly flat across the
form gradient — it cannot reproduce the 9×-from-bottom-to-top win-rate rise that form encodes. the
bin-level tracking correlation is moderate (+0.78 / +0.86) because the ordering is roughly right,
but the slope — the load-bearing quantity for win discrimination — is essentially zero.

## (3) what re-emerges / what is still missing
**re-emerges (weak but real):** the strictly-prior hill v_c carries a small de-confounded ability
signal that beats the rating floor (held-out-form corr +0.066 st / +0.033 hv vs +0.015 / −0.022),
and the de-confounded-cruise group is the one subset where the pure model out-sharpens production on
its winners (δ−0.085 st). the 0049 finding (the de-confounded level re-emerges as held-out ability)
holds — it is just the slope-based `vc_hill` that is too thin to carry it into the win gate.

**still missing (the gap to recovery):**
1. **the ability read is too coarse.** `vc_hill` (across-distance slope, ≤3 prior distances on most
   horses) is far noisier than the de-confounded level (0049: +0.33/+0.40). the payoff path should
   carry the **de-confounded settled-cruise level** (the 0049 estimator) as the primary ability,
   with the hill slope only where the distance span supports it — that is the single highest-leverage
   fix and it stays pure-mechanism.
2. **deployment ≠ discrimination.** the field-coupled forward path fits the within-race velocity
   profile (0049) but the between-horse ability spread it implies is compressed (drift clamped to
   12–19 m/s, σ_v ≈ a few tenths) — too tight to separate a 17.5% from a 1.9% win-rate horse. the
   generative law needs the ability variance the meta-signal stack supplies; physiology at this
   measurement precision under-spreads.
3. **path-fit bar still fails vs the descriptive cell-mean** (field-coupled hill rmse 1.385 vs 0.456
   st; 1.099 vs 0.407 hv, bias +1.10 / +0.88 m/s) — the hill-cp-anchored forward integrator over-runs
   (the literature w′₀/p_max defaults + the static-de-confound cp, not the per-run 0047 inversion).
   consistent with 0049's note that the static de-confound leaves a +0.7 m/s pace-following residual.
   this bar (already flagged 0047/0049) gates the ability read precision in (1).

## verdict
the pure-mechanism causal payoff test is run and reported, both venues, leak-free (drift 0). the
gof fall is to the floor (st 65.4%→−7.6%, hv 60.0%→+4.6%), driven by the stripped ability stack on
raced horses (winner −log p δ+0.58/+0.53 on hill horses) more than the debut concession. form does
not re-emerge at the win gate: the path hill v_c beats the rating floor on held-out form (+0.066 vs
+0.015 st) but sits far below the form ceiling (+0.382) and recovers only 7%/4% of the empirical
form→win gradient. the cause is identifiable and weakly predictive; the meta-signals do not yet
re-emerge as consequences strong enough to price winners. the named next step is to carry the 0049
de-confounded level (not the thin hill slope) as the ability and to restore the between-horse spread
the generative law lost. don't-bake — diagnostic measurement; no production constant changed; win%
measured, never optimized.

## discipline
no meta-signal in the model (the builder imports zero of `hkjc.model.features`; θ = hill-cp /
de-confounded cruise / rating-conditioned population mean only). no odds-gating — win% is measured
on the gate, never optimized; coupling gains left at default. form appears only as a held-out
correlation/binning target, never a model input. strictly-prior leak-free: `assert_no_lookahead`
drift = 0 both venues. reused the production gate (`gate_score`) and the leak-free frame
(`studies/backtest_st.py::load`) verbatim — same judge the production model answers to. new files:
`studies/causal_reemergence.py` (+ the leak-free assert wired in). `pure_mechanism.py`, the
statespace physics, production `hkjc.model`, and `data_cache` untouched. lint clean.

text:
"refactor 0051: the lean purge — delete the acausal additive-regression win model (fit.py / features.py / constants.py, ~111k) and fold hkjc.statespace into the canonical hkjc.model namespace. hkjc.model now is the causal-physics generative model; there is no frozen fallback. tests 190→171 green (−19 = the 3 deleted acausal test files), ruff clean. docs/state/agent-prompts reconciled to the causal reality and the honest 0050 status (form does not yet re-emerge at the win gate). the journal is the rebuild trail." refactor lean purge anti-regression acausal-delete namespace-fold statespace hkjc-model canonical-namespace causal causal-rebuild wald-constants constants-relocation docs-reconcile model-state claude-md agent-prompts model-design philosophy tests-green ruff-clean journal-as-trail 0046 0049 0050 queue-57 final — the lean purge that the causal pivot (thread 0046) earned. with the pure-mechanism payoff
test run and recorded (0050: the meta-signal-free model is honest and identifiable but does not yet
re-emerge form at the win gate), the user directed: keep the codebase lean, **delete** the acausal
regression model (not freeze it), and **abandon the `hkjc.statespace` namespace** — it is redundant
with `hkjc.model`, which is canonical. the journal is the full research trail; deleted scratch can
be rebuilt from it. this entry records what was removed, what was kept, and the new shape.

## (1) deleted — the acausal additive-regression win model (~111k of source)

- **`src/hkjc/model/fit.py`** (39k) — the production additive-regression assembly
  (`fit_predict_traffic`): the eb ability → win-prob pipeline with the meta-signal couplings layered
  on. the "regression dressed up as physics" the pivot rejected.
- **`src/hkjc/model/features.py`** (57k) — every meta-signal table: recency-form, jockey, collateral
  (massey), rating-peakgap, trajectory-fade, barrier-trial, training-gallop, gate-break, speed-figure
  dispersion. these were consumed as inputs; the causal thesis is they must re-emerge as consequences.
- **`src/hkjc/model/constants.py`** (15k) — the baked regression-gain tables (form_gain, jockey_gain,
  collat_gain, trial_pi_ratio, …). all dead once `fit.py` went.
- **tests** of the deleted code: `test_features.py`, `test_gallop_fusion.py`, `test_trial_fusion.py`.
- **25 obsolete studies** that imported the deleted modules (the acausal probes + the production-
  comparison gate studies: `backtest_st.py`, `statespace_*_gate.py`, `causal_reemergence.py`,
  `ability_collapse_probe.py`, the mass/allometric/peakgap/gallop/trial probes, `quick_eval.py`, …).
  their results live in journals 0042–0050; the scripts depended on the now-deleted production baseline.

**there is no frozen fallback.** the prior plan (philosophy §9, model_state) framed the acausal model
as a deployable fallback kept until the causal model surpassed it. the user overrode that: lean beats
a safety net we can rebuild from the journal. deleting it also enforces anti-regression structurally —
you cannot backslide into a model that no longer exists.

## (2) folded — `hkjc.statespace` → `hkjc.model` (one canonical namespace)

the causal-physics package built alongside production (journals 0045–0050) was moved wholesale into
`hkjc.model` (no name collisions): `dynamics, identify, field, generative, pricer, gate, pipeline,
coupling, latent, conditions, causes, likelihood, pathfit, pure_mechanism`. `hkjc.statespace`
is gone. (`assembly.py` — the production-reproduction bridge that stamped production `v_c_eb` for the
byte-exact acceptance gate a: `production_theta_builder`/`make_production_pre_fit`/`attach_trailing_*`
— was deleted rather than folded; with production gone it was dead code, zero live callers.) `hkjc.model` is the causal-physics generative win model; `hkjc.model.__init__` re-exports the
full causal surface plus the retained substrate. all `hkjc.statespace.x` references across src/tests/
studies/docs were rewritten to `hkjc.model.x`; `docs/statespace_design.md` → `docs/model_design.md`.

## (3) kept — physics + honest references (not the regression model)

`energetics`, `energetics_dynamic` (critical-velocity / dynamic w'-balance engines); `calibration`,
`calibration_bayes` (eb band×rating population prior — the debut concession the pure build leans on);
`plackett_luce`, `harville_model`, `conditional_logit`, `baselines` (the harville-on-odds, results-logit,
and market/uniform references the causal model is scored against — `core` builds pl, and philosophy §8
keeps the market as the final yardstick). the handful of coupling constants the generative pricer still
reads (`draw_*`, `figvar_*`, `draw_var_*`, `gate_break_*`) were relocated verbatim into
**`src/hkjc/model/wald_constants.py`**, which severs the last dependence on the deleted `constants.py`
and documents them as provisional acausal debt (draw→geometry, figvar→d, gate-break→eom transient).

## (4) verification

- **tests: 190 → 171, all green.** the −19 is exactly the three deleted acausal test files; nothing
  else regressed. the folded package imports cleanly (36 exports after dropping the dead assembly
  bridge); the leak-free `test_model_skeleton` and `test_pure_mechanism` (no-meta-signal-import
  guard) pass against the new layout.
- **`ruff check src/hkjc tests studies` clean.** `pyproject` per-file-ignores re-pointed to `model/`.
- no dangling references to the deleted modules remain in code (only historical provenance mentions).

## (5) docs / state reconciled to the causal reality + the honest 0050 status

`claude.md` (working guide), `journal/state/model_state.md` (rewritten from the deleted-model constants
table to the causal architecture + identified physical constants + the 0050 verdict + the ranked
queue), `src/hkjc/__init__.py`, `docs/{philosophy, causal_model, model_design, research_program,
theory}.md`, and the modelling/strategist agent prompts. every status line states the truth: the gof
fell to the floor, **form does not yet re-emerge at the win gate** (7%/4% of the gradient), and the
named next step is the ability-anchor **slope → de-confounded level** swap (0049's +0.33/+0.40 lever).
no doc claims the causal model matches the old 65% or that form re-emerges.

## (6) where this leaves the rebuild

the repo is now a single lean causal-physics codebase with no acausal escape hatch. the next modelling
move is unchanged from 0050's diagnosis and now unobstructed: re-anchor `pure_mechanism` ability on the
de-confounded cruise level, rebuild a lean re-emergence eval (vs market/uniform — the production arm is
gone by design), and test whether form re-emerges. the fall is closed by adding causal structure, never
by reviving the deleted meta-signals.

The fusion LANDS NEAR de-confounded (as designed) but the de-confounded level — measured here as a strictly-prior EXPANDING-MEAN ability read over a horse's ALL prior runs on the BROAD path population (n=15,663 ST / 6,304 HV) — is itself WEAK (≈+0.09/+0.02 vs rf_now), NOT the +0.33/+0.40 of the 0049 route-only split-half PERSISTENCE test. read's hard priority chain (hill slope first) with a precision-weighted fusion of the instruments —
`hkjc.model.pure_mechanism.fuse_vc_read(vc_hill, vc_hill_se, vc_decon, vc_decon_n, vc_decon_sd,
vc_pop)`, the single source of truth feeding the win drift. the #55/0050 finding motivating it: the
hill slope read barely correlates with form (ρ≈+0.066 st / +0.033 hv) while the de-confounded cruise
level re-emerges form near the ceiling (≈+0.33/+0.40, journal 0049). the fusion is meant to land near
the de-confounded level. this entry measures whether it does. new lean harness
`studies/ability_read_check.py` (also the reusable identification harness s5 extends); src/hkjc read

## the harness — lean, leak-free, three reads on the same rows
build the strictly-prior `build_pure_mechanism_panel(traj, results_rich)`. for every run with a
path-based ability read (hill or de-confounded present) assemble three candidate reads on the same
aligned rows: `vc_hill` (hill slope alone), `vc_decon` (de-confounded level alone), `vc_fused`
(`fuse_vc_read` on the panel columns — the production read; `vc_pop` passed nan so the fusion is a
genuine hill↔de-confounded precision blend, exactly the production read for a path-based runner).

form target (the stripped meta-signal, used purely as a correlation target, never an input):
`rf = 1 − (finish_pos−1)/(field_size−1)` ∈ [0,1] (1 = win), the relative finish. two strictly-prior
windows, both computed from finishes prior to the run (shifted one race back, leak-free):
  * `form`          — exp-weighted recency form, half-life 2 races (the production `form_half_life`),
                       i.e. the exact production `recency_form_table` signal, recomputed from
                       `results_rich` so the harness has no production-frame dependency.
  * `trailing_form` — the expanding career-mean of `rf` (a different prior window) → the form
                       autocorrelation ceiling.
rating floor: the strictly-prior official handicap rating (`rating_dataset.parquet`), as-of join by
(horse_id, date). all five correlations use the same aligned rows so they are comparable.

two targets are reported. table a uses the task-spec strictly-prior recency-form as the target (so
the ceiling is form's own autocorrelation). table b uses the run's own realised finish `rf_now` — the
0050 headline-(a) target — so the absolute levels are directly comparable to the 0050 baselines.

## the tables (pearson ρ; aligned path rows; st n=15,663, hv n=6,304)
coverage: st hill 8,395 / de-confounded 15,663; hv hill 1,665 / de-confounded 6,304 (matches 0050).

table a — target = strictly-prior recency-form (half-life 2, shift 1); ceiling = form autocorrelation
| venue | n | ρ(fused) | ρ(hill) | ρ(decon) | ρ(rating floor) | ρ(form ceiling) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | 15,663 | **+0.188** | +0.233 | +0.211 | +0.238 | +0.895 |
| **hv** | 6,304  | **+0.148** | +0.134 | +0.133 | +0.292 | +0.917 |

table b — target = the run's own realised finish `rf_now` (0050 headline-(a), baseline-comparable)
| venue | n | ρ(fused) | ρ(hill) | ρ(decon) | ρ(rating floor) | ρ(form ceiling) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | 15,663 | **+0.083** | +0.098 | +0.091 | −0.001 | +0.312 |
| **hv** | 6,304  | **+0.020** | +0.055 | +0.015 | −0.026 | +0.250 |
| 0050 baseline | — | — | +0.066/+0.033 | ≈+0.33/+0.40 | +0.015/−0.022 | +0.382/+0.302 |

## the verdict — the fusion is mechanically correct but does not beat the hill read here
**the fusion does what it was built to do at the mechanism level.** where both instruments exist, the
fused read sits ~2.8× closer to the de-confounded level than to the noisy hill slope
(mean|fused−decon| = 0.30 vs |fused−hill| = 0.83 m/s at st; 0.34 vs 0.50 m/s at hv; corr(fused,decon)
0.72 vs corr(fused,hill) 0.52 at st). the precision weighting does down-weight the short-lever-arm
hill slope toward the de-confounded level — the #55/0050 intent, obtained by mechanism not by hand.

**but the fusion does not lift the ability→form correlation above the hill read.** all three reads
sit in a tight cluster on both targets and both venues — vs `rf_now`: fused +0.083 / hill +0.098 /
decon +0.091 (st); +0.020 / +0.055 / +0.015 (hv). the fused read lands near de-confounded
(|fused−decon| ρ ≤ 0.01 on rf_now, both venues — the design goal) but does not beat hill (it is
fractionally below hill at st and below hill at hv). all three clear the rating floor (≈0.00/−0.03,
reproducing 0050's near-zero floor) but all three sit far below the form-autocorrelation ceiling
(+0.31/+0.25 vs rf_now; +0.90/+0.92 vs prior recency-form).

**the decisive caveat — why "land near de-confounded" did not deliver the expected lift.** the
de-confounded level here (`vc_decon`, a strictly-prior expanding-mean of a horse's de-confounded
cruise over all its prior runs, on the broad path population, n=15,663/6,304) reads only ≈+0.09/+0.02
vs realised finish — it is not the +0.33/+0.40 of the 0049 headline. that +0.33/+0.40 was a
different measurement: a route-only (≥1800 m) split-half persistence correlation (early-half mean →
held-out late-half mean, n=414 st / 296 hv). recast as the per-run strictly-prior point estimate that
the panel and the fusion actually feed the win drift, on the full population, the de-confounded
re-emergence largely disappears. so the fusion lands exactly where it was aimed — but the target it
lands near is weak in the form the production read uses it. the 0050 narrative ("swap slope→level and
the +0.33/+0.40 re-emergence flows in") does not hold once "level" is the broad-population per-run
de-confounded mean; the lift lives in the route-only split-half setup, which is not what feeds θ.

## what this means for s2 / s5 (honest, decision-relevant)
- **s1 closed the mechanism (the read now blends by precision toward the level) but not the payoff
  (the ability→form correlation did not rise above the hill slope).** the expected jump from the
  slope→level swap is not realised on the population the drift sees. proceeding to s2 expecting the
  fusion alone to re-emerge form is not supported by this measurement.
- **the +0.33/+0.40 de-confounded re-emergence is real but setup-bound** (route-only, split-half
  persistence). if s2/s5 want that signal in the win drift, the panel must reproduce that estimator
  (e.g. a route-restricted, multi-reading de-confounded persistence read), not the current
  all-distance expanding mean — or enrich the path-inferred ability beyond a single per-run level
  (margins surface + closing precision + the pace-interaction layer in the win drift, the 0050 §4.4
  pointer), which is the structurally honest route.
- **the harness is the reusable s5 spine.** lean, leak-free (ability + both form windows strictly
  prior), no production-frame dependency, both venues, lint clean. it can carry any future ability
  read as a new column and re-run the same five-correlation comparison.

## discipline
first-principles, no regression, no meta-signal as an input — form is a correlation target only,
never fed to any ability read. leak-free: the path physiology is strictly-prior by panel construction
(a run's own path never enters its anchor); both form windows are shifted one race back; the rating is
an as-of (backward) join. src/hkjc read only — no model file modified. `fuse_vc_read` /
`build_pure_mechanism_panel` imported untouched. lint clean (`ruff check studies/ability_read_check.py`).

text:
"s4 multi-pool gate: score the mid-rebuild model's skill% across the efficiency-weighted pool book (win/place/quinella/quinella-place/forecast/tierce/trio), not just win, as functionals of the one joint orderdistribution. the pricer exotics are completed (qpl added; place() now sources k from hkjc_facts; dead-heat/refund routed to the settlement seam, not the order-prob functionals). new studies/pool_book_gate.py scores every pool's exact %-of-market on the realized winning combination vs honest baselines — the de-vigged dividend (market = (1−takeout)/decimal, takeout sourced from hkjc_facts) and the uniform no-skill order law (same pricer) — leak-free (assert_no_lookahead drift = 0), paired fixed-seed (pythonhashseed=0), both venues. model = path-energetics θ (v_c, w') pooled strictly-prior by the train-only eb population (calibration.horse_energetics_trailing), no meta-signal, via build_fit_predict + the default θ-builder (does not depend on the in-flight ability-read fusion, 0052). verdict (honest, mid-rebuild): the model captures a small but uniformly positive slice of the market across the whole book — st win 10.9% / pla 12.4% / qin 12.2% / qpl 13.0% / fct 12.3% / tce 9.9% / tri 13.0% of market; hv win 9.9% (dividends st-only, so hv exotics are not scorable from disk). the joint/ordering pools (qin/qpl/fct/tri ≈12–13%) track the sharp win anchor (≈11%) rather than collapsing relative to it — the joint structure of the order distribution is no worse per-pool than its win marginal, but it does not yet add skill beyond win either. this is a measurement of the rebuild's gof floor (consistent with 0050's win fall), not a fitting target; the path-energetics generator is far below the deleted model's 65%/60% as expected." s4 pool-book multi-pool gate pricer order-distribution win place quinella quinella-place qpl forecast tierce trio exotics percent-of-market de-vig dividends market-baseline uniform-baseline efficiency-weighted joint-structure leak-free strictly-prior paired-fixed-seed both-venues gof-fall last-yardstick first-principles no-regression hkjc-facts places-paid takeout dead-heat 0043 0050 0052 s4 — the multi-pool gate (research_program §4, rq-pool-*). the win gate scores only the order
distribution's left tail; this scores the whole joint object. every hkjc pool is a functional of the
one `orderdistribution` (`hkjc.model.pricer`), so a single monte-carlo sample prices the whole book
consistently. this is the last yardstick (philosophy §6) — a measurement of the mid-rebuild model,
never a fitting target.

## what was built

1. **pricer exotics completed as functionals of the one joint order distribution**
   (`src/hkjc/model/pricer.py`, owned). added `prob_quinella_place(i,j,k)` (qpl — both runners in the
   top-k set, the pairwise top-k analogue of the existing pairwise top-2 `prob_quinella`). `place()`
   now sources `k` from `hkjc.core.hkjc_facts.places_paid` (3 for 7+, 2 for 4–6, 0 for tiny fields)
   instead of a hard-coded default. dead-heat / refund are documented as a settlement-seam concern
   (they split the payout, not the order-probability the gate scores) and routed there, not into the
   order-prob functionals — sourced from `hkjc_facts`, not hard-coded. the dense `(n,n,n)` trifecta
   tensor stays a deliberate `notimplementederror` (the gate needs only `prob_trio`/`prob_tierce` on
   the realized combination, never the full tensor). win/place/forecast/quinella/tierce/trio were
   already correct monte-carlo functionals; left intact.

2. **`studies/pool_book_gate.py`** (new, owned). per-pool %-of-market on the realized winning
   combination vs two honest baselines, leak-free, paired fixed-seed, both venues.

## the model and the baselines (honest, leak-free)

- **model.** per-runner drift θ = (v_c, w') is the horse's path-inferred energetics
  (`data_cache/energetics_dataset_full.parquet`), pooled strictly-prior by the train-only eb
  population (`calibration.fit_energetics_population` on train dates only +
  `calibration.horse_energetics_trailing`, an expanding window over each horse's earlier runs). no
  meta-signal column is read. the order distribution is the existing generative wald first-passage law
  via `build_fit_predict` + the default θ-builder + `predict_race` — so this does not depend on the
  in-flight ability-read fusion (0052). a horse with no path history falls back to the band population
  mean. `assert_no_lookahead` drift = **0.00e+00** on both venues (strictly-prior, outcome-blind).
- **market (honest baseline).** the de-vigged dividend: market prob of the realized combination =
  `(1 − takeout) / decimal`, takeout sourced from `hkjc_facts.takeout_for` (win/pla/qin/qpl 17.5%,
  fct/tce 20.5%, tri 25%). partial by construction: the dividend prices only the realized (winning)
  combination, so %market is on that one combination (the 0043 caveat).
- **uniform (honest baseline).** the no-skill order law — every runner equally fast
  (independent-uniform argmin) — priced through the same `poolpricer`, so the baseline carries the
  honest no-information joint structure, not a hand-set number.
- **metric.** the exact win %market definition (`gate.pool_book_score` / `_pct_of_market`),
  per pool, on the realized-combination nll:
  `%market = (uniform_ll − model_ll) / (uniform_ll − market_ll)`.

## result (pythonhashseed=0, n_samples=8000, paired fixed-seed, bit-reproducible run-to-run)

per-pool skill% on the dividend test window (st 170 dividend races, mar–may 2026; population fit on
all st dates before the window):

```
  pool      n   %market    model_ll market_ll  unif_ll   p_model    p_mkt
  win     170    10.9%      2.4802    2.0493   2.5329    0.0865   0.1818
  pla     170    12.4%      1.3986    1.1212   1.4379    0.2517   0.3780   (per placed-runner leg)
  qin     170    12.2%      4.1663    3.3859   4.2748    0.0170   0.0573
  qpl     168    13.0%      3.1121    2.4933   3.2050    0.0475   0.1188
  fct     170    12.3%      4.8576    4.0806   4.9661    0.0086   0.0313
  tce     170     9.9%      7.0691    6.0621   7.1797    0.0011   0.0066
  tri     170    13.0%      5.3651    4.4469   5.5027    0.0059   0.0249

  hv  win  206    9.9%      2.4244    2.0725   2.4631    0.0927   0.1619   (wpq holdout; hv dividends not on disk)
```

## reading it (honest)

- the model captures a small but uniformly positive slice of the market across the entire book —
  ~10–13% of market on every pool, st and hv. positive = it beats uniform everywhere; far below 100%
  = far below the market, and far below the deleted model's recorded 65%/60% win benchmark, exactly as
  the 0050 gof fall predicts for a meta-signal-free path generator.
- **the joint/ordering pools do not collapse relative to the sharp win anchor.** qin/qpl/fct/tri sit
  at ~12–13%, slightly above the win anchor's ~11% — i.e. the joint structure of the order
  distribution is no worse per-pool than its win marginal. but this is not yet evidence the joint
  carries skill win cannot: the clean rq-pool-quin test (joint vs win-marginals×independence) is not
  run here, and the uniform baseline's joint is also independent-argmin, so the ~12% is consistent with
  the model's per-pool edge being driven by the same v_c spread that drives win. tce (ordered top-3) is
  the weakest at 9.9% — the deepest ordered structure is where the coarse energetics θ has least to
  say, as expected.
- this is a gof-floor measurement of the rebuild, recorded per philosophy §6 — not optimized, not a
  gate the build must pass.

## caveats / notes for the orchestrator

- **dividends are st-only on disk** (`data_cache/dividends_st.parquet`); hv exotics are not scorable
  until an `dividends_hv.parquet` lands. the study auto-detects `dividends_{venue}.parquet` and slots
  hv in when present; meanwhile hv reports the win anchor from the wpq panel (real market_win_prob).
- **partial benchmark (0043).** %market is on the realized winning combination only (the dividend does
  not expose the market's full distribution over losing combinations). valid for a per-pool skill read,
  not a full cross-entropy against the market book.
- **the order distribution had everything the exotics need** — the joint mc sample is sufficient; no
  missing field in `orderdistribution`. no request to edit `generative.py`/`field.py`/etc.
- **efficiency weighting** (§4: a single weighted pool-book number, sharp anchors full weight, exotics
  down-weighted) is reported here as the per-pool table rather than collapsed to one scalar, so the
  decisive mass (win/place) is legible separately from the soft exotics; collapsing to one weighted
  number is a trivial post-step if a scalar gate is wanted.

## discipline

leak-free (drift = 0, both venues), strictly-prior θ, paired fixed-seed (bit-identical run-to-run),
no meta-signal in the model input, no win/pool optimization (pure measurement). `pythonhashseed=0
uv run pytest -q` green (172 passed, incl. the new `test_pricer_qpl_and_place_field_size_rule`);
`uv run ruff check` clean.

title: "S1b PATH ABILITY-CEILING ORACLE (#68, decision-gating): what is the BEST achievable strictly-prior path→form correlation from ALL longitudinal-sectional signals combined, vs the single fused read (0052)? NEW studies/path_ability_ceiling.py assembles a strictly-prior FEATURE MATRIX of every path-derived signal (opening/mid/closing/mean section velocity, velocity range, late deceleration, settled cruise, de-confounded cruise, Hill v_c/W'/n_dist) in TWO leak-free forms — PER-RUN (lag-1, the most-recent-prior run) and CAREER (expanding prior-mean) — plus contemporaneous mass/distance/going, and takes the ORACLE = max OUT-OF-SAMPLE Pearson ρ(regularized-ridge linear combo, leak-free form target) via 5-fold-CV-tuned ridge with POOLED out-of-fold prediction (NOT in-sample R²). VERDICT: UNDER-EXTRACTED, not ability-poor. Against the run's own realised finish rf_now the career oracle reaches ST +0.231 / HV +0.157 vs the single fused read +0.083/+0.020 (a 2.8×/7.8× LIFT) and the rating floor ≈0 — landing at 74%/63% of the form CEILING (+0.312/+0.250). The signal IS in the longitudinal path; the single critical-velocity fusion throws ~⅔ of it away. The lift lives in the CAREER-MEAN RAW SECTION VELOCITIES (career-vel-only oracle +0.202 ST, ≈ the full +0.231), NOT in distance (distance-only +0.017) and NOT in the Hill/de-confounded panel alone (+0.108) — the fusion collapsing the path to one v_c number is the bottleneck. The oracle is robust to horse-grouped CV (ST +0.227 / HV +0.141, ≈ random-split), so no per-horse memorization inflation. RECOMMENDATION: FIX the read (career EB aggregation of the raw section-velocity profile, not just a single fused v_c level) before any pivot — the path is NOT yet exhausted."

summary: S1b — THE DECISION-GATING DIAGNOSTIC. S1 (0052) found the precision-weighted FUSED path ability read correlates with the leak-free form target at only ρ≈+0.083 (ST) / +0.020 (HV), barely above the rat…
text:
"s1b path ability-ceiling oracle (#68, decision-gating): what is the best achievable strictly-prior path→form correlation from all longitudinal-sectional signals combined, vs the single fused read (0052)? new studies/path_ability_ceiling.py assembles a strictly-prior feature matrix of every path-derived signal (opening/mid/closing/mean section velocity, velocity range, late deceleration, settled cruise, de-confounded cruise, hill v_c/w'/n_dist) in two leak-free forms — per-run (lag-1, the most-recent-prior run) and career (expanding prior-mean) — plus contemporaneous mass/distance/going, and takes the oracle = max out-of-sample pearson ρ(regularized-ridge linear combo, leak-free form target) via 5-fold-cv-tuned ridge with pooled out-of-fold prediction (not in-sample r²). verdict: under-extracted, not ability-poor. against the run's own realised finish rf_now the career oracle reaches st +0.231 / hv +0.157 vs the single fused read +0.083/+0.020 (a 2.8×/7.8× lift) and the rating floor ≈0 — landing at 74%/63% of the form ceiling (+0.312/+0.250). the signal is in the longitudinal path; the single critical-velocity fusion throws ~⅔ of it away. the lift lives in the career-mean raw section velocities (career-vel-only oracle +0.202 st, ≈ the full +0.231), not in distance (distance-only +0.017) and not in the hill/de-confounded panel alone (+0.108) — the fusion collapsing the path to one v_c number is the bottleneck. the oracle is robust to horse-grouped cv (st +0.227 / hv +0.141, ≈ random-split), so no per-horse memorization inflation. recommendation: fix the read (career eb aggregation of the raw section-velocity profile, not just a single fused v_c level) before any pivot — the path is not yet exhausted." s1b oracle ability-ceiling ability-read path-physics longitudinal-sectional feature-matrix career-aggregation expanding-mean per-run ridge out-of-sample held-out k-fold cross-validation form form-target recency-form rf-now re-emergence reemergence rating-floor form-ceiling under-extracted not-ability-poor section-velocity settled-cruise deconfounded-cruise hill critical-velocity fuse-vc-read decision-gating leak-free strictly-prior first-principles no-regression 0049 0050 0052 s1b — the decision-gating diagnostic. s1 (0052) found the precision-weighted fused path ability read
correlates with the leak-free form target at only ρ≈+0.083 (st) / +0.020 (hv), barely above the
rating floor (≈0) and far below the trailing-form ceiling (+0.31/+0.25). that measured one fused
instrument. the prior question, which decides whether to keep mining the path or pivot to new data:
what is the best achievable strictly-prior path→form correlation from all longitudinal-sectional
signals combined — the oracle? new `studies/path_ability_ceiling.py`; src/hkjc read only (untouched);
lint clean; reuses `ability_read_check.py`'s loaders + the same leak-free form target so the numbers
are directly comparable to 0052.

## the harness — a strictly-prior feature matrix in two forms, out-of-sample ridge oracle
feature matrix = every signal physically derivable from the longitudinal sectional path + known
conditions: opening / mid (cruise) / closing / mean section velocity, velocity range, late
deceleration (mid→closing), settled cruise (`identify.settled_cruise_velocity`), de-confounded cruise
(`field.deconfounded_cruise_velocity`), hill v_c / w' / n_dist (`build_pure_mechanism_panel`), plus
contemporaneous declared mass / carried weight / distance / going (pre-race public, allowed for path
reconstruction, phil §7). built in two leak-free forms: (a) per-run = the horse's most-recent-prior
run's path features (lag-1 — a run's own path never enters its own features); (b) career =
expanding mean of each feature over all the horse's prior runs. the hill/de-confounded panel reads
are already strictly-prior expanding by construction.

oracle = max out-of-sample pearson ρ(regularized linear combo, form target). a ridge with a
5-fold-cv-tuned penalty, fit on train folds and scored on the held-out fold; out-of-fold predictions
are pooled (every row predicted by a model that never saw it) and the λ with the best pooled oos ρ is
the oracle. not an in-sample r² (which would be a meaningless inflated "oracle"). missing features are
mean-imputed with a missingness indicator so thin-history runners still contribute. same row
alignment as 0052 (a path-based ability read present: hill or de-confounded).

## the table (pearson ρ, out-of-sample; aligned path rows; st n=15,663, hv n=6,304)
target = the run's own realised finish rf_now (0052 table b — the target whose baselines the task quotes)
| venue | n | oracle per-run | oracle career | fused (0052) | rating floor | form ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | 15,663 | +0.226 | **+0.231** | +0.083 | −0.001 | +0.312 |
| **hv** | 6,304  | +0.173 | **+0.157** | +0.020 | −0.026 | +0.250 |

target = strictly-prior recency-form (half-life 2, shift 1; 0052 table a — ceiling = form autocorrelation)
| venue | n | oracle per-run | oracle career | fused (0052) | rating floor | form ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | 15,663 | +0.534 | **+0.560** | +0.188 | +0.238 | +0.895 |
| **hv** | 6,304  | +0.507 | **+0.525** | +0.148 | +0.292 | +0.917 |

(the recency-form ceiling +0.90/+0.92 is the form autocorrelation — a different, near-trivial target;
rf_now is the decision-relevant one, hence the headline.)

## the verdict — under-extracted, not ability-poor
the career-aggregated oracle (rf_now) reaches **st +0.231 / hv +0.157**, a **2.8× / 7.8× lift** over
the single fused read (+0.083 / +0.020) and far above the rating floor (≈0). it lands at **74% / 63%
of the form ceiling** (+0.312 / +0.250). this is the fix end of the spectrum, not the pivot end: the
ability signal is present in the longitudinal sectional path; the single critical-velocity fusion
discards roughly two-thirds of it. the per-run (lag-1) and career oracles are close (st +0.226 vs
+0.231; hv +0.173 vs +0.157) — even one prior run's full path profile beats the fused read; the
career mean adds a little at st.

## where the signal lives (feature-subset oracles, st, rf_now)
- distance only → +0.017 (not a distance/velocity-scale artifact).
- contemporaneous conditions only (dist+mass+carried-wt+going) → +0.074 (carried weight = the
  handicap boundary carries a little; legitimate pre-race public).
- career raw section velocities only (open/close/mean/mid/range/late-decel) → **+0.202** — essentially
  the whole oracle.
- hill/de-confounded panel only → +0.108 (the panel that feeds the fused read tops out near the
  fused value — confirming the fusion is not the bottleneck's victim, it is the bottleneck).
- no-conditions (career path + panel, 16 dims) → +0.223 ≈ the full +0.231.
top standardized ridge weights (career, rf_now): st = v_open +0.37, v_mean −0.35, v_close +0.26,
v_mid +0.26, w'_hill −0.26, v_c_hill −0.24 (the raw section-velocity profile — its shape, opening
vs mean vs closing — not a single level). hv is flatter and noisier (top: v_close +0.07,
late_decel −0.07, carried-wt +0.04) consistent with hv's thinner hill coverage and shorter trips.

## why the fusion missed it (reconciles 0050/0052)
0052 showed the fused read lands near the de-confounded level but that level is weak as a
broad-population per-run point estimate. s1b explains it: collapsing the path to one critical-velocity
number (whether hill slope, de-confounded level, or their precision blend) is lossy. the form-relevant
ability lives in the multi-dimensional career velocity profile — the relationship among opening,
cruise, and closing section speeds across a horse's prior runs — which a single v_c scalar cannot
carry. the 0050 "swap slope→level" framing was too narrow; the fix is to feed the career-aggregated
section-velocity profile (richer than any one level), de-confounded, into the read.

## recommendation (decision-gating outcome)
**fix the read, do not pivot.** concretely: career-aggregate (eb-shrunk over prior runs) the
de-confounded section-velocity profile — opening / cruise / closing levels and their shape — rather
than a single fused v_c, and let the win drift read that richer ability surface. the +0.23/+0.16
oracle is the realistic upper bound a path-only read can reach (≈¾ of form's own ceiling); the gap
to the ceiling is the part of ability the longitudinal path does not see (lateral/positional control,
trip trouble — the cv-lateral-path territory), but that is the last mile, not the first. the
longitudinal path is not yet exhausted.

## caveat on the oos method (could the oracle be biased?)
the k-fold split is row-level random, so a horse can appear in both train and test folds — a
potential per-horse memorization inflation. a horse-grouped 5-fold (all of a horse's runs held out
together) gives st +0.227 / hv +0.141 — essentially identical (st −0.004, hv −0.016), as expected for
a linear ridge with no per-horse features (it cannot memorize a per-horse offset). so the oracle is
not inflated by leakage across the split; if anything the random-split number is a hair generous at
hv. the oracle is also a ceiling in the sense that it cv-selects the best λ on the pooled oos ρ
(picking the penalty by the held-out score is mildly optimistic, but with 9 coarse λ candidates and
n≫p this is negligible — the per-λ curve is flat near the optimum). lower bound: the oracle could be
slightly understated because (a) it is purely linear (a non-linear combiner could read interactions
among the velocity profile), and (b) the de-confounded cruise here is the per-run all-distance read,
not the route-only persistence estimator that scored +0.33/+0.40 in 0049. net: +0.23/+0.16 is a
trustworthy, slightly-conservative estimate of the path-only ceiling.

## discipline
first-principles, no regression of the outcome into the model — the ridge is a diagnostic oracle
(measuring the achievable correlation), never a build; form is a correlation target only, never an
input to any read. leak-free: every path feature is strictly-prior (lag-1 or expanding prior-mean,
the run's own path excluded), the form targets are shifted one race back, the rating is an as-of
backward join; conditions are pre-race public. src/hkjc read only — no model file modified
(`build_pure_mechanism_panel`, `settled_cruise_velocity`, `deconfounded_cruise_velocity` imported
untouched). lint clean (`ruff check studies/path_ability_ceiling.py`). full pytest suite not run (per
task). don't-bake — a decision-gating measurement; no production constant changed. the finding is
recorded as-is: the longitudinal sectional path is under-extracted by the single fused v_c read (the
career-section-velocity-profile oracle reaches ¾ of the form ceiling at st, 4–8× the fused read both
venues) — the program should fix the read (career-aggregated de-confounded velocity profile) before
pivoting to new data.

scale-up plan. owns `src/hkjc/vision/` + `studies/cv_*.py` only; `src/hkjc/model|core`
and `data_cache` panels are untouched (geometry consumed read-only via `hkjc.core.track`).

## (0) the substrate — `aerial_sample.mp4` is the *aerial virtual view*, not a drone
the clip (1920×1080, 25 fps, 118 s) is hkjc's **synthetic "aerial virtual view"** product,
not raw aerial footage. each frame is split: the left half is a real broadcast pan
(occluded / motion-blurred — ignored); the right half is a **top-down rendered animation**
of the runners on a uniform brown track, with **both rails drawn as white curves**, a
**distance odometer** ("1600m"→"100m"), and a **bottom legend strip** of silk icons +
saddlecloth numbers in current running order. hkjc itself labels it an approximation
("refer to real replay for actual results").

this reframes the task. the prior recon (journal trail + `studies/cv_feasibility_probe.py`,
`poc_out/extract_run.log`) showed generic yolo returns **0 detections on 88/111 overhead
frames** — that verdict stands (cuda is off here; a coco `horse` class does not fire on a
~15 px synthetic sprite). but on the *render* the right tool is **classical colour
segmentation**: runners are vivid silk blobs against a low-saturation track, the rails are
literally drawn, and the camera-motion problem dissolves because we work in **rail-relative
coordinates measured per frame** — the per-frame rail fit is the lateral-axis stabiliser;
no global homography is needed for `y_lat`.

## (1) the pipeline — modular, in `src/hkjc/vision/mode_b/`
import-safe with no heavy deps (cv2/av/numpy lazy). five stages + driver:

| module | does |
|---|---|
| `layout.py` | per-frame rois of the right panel (legend band located from the data; the track band drifts with the camera); flags `aerial_active` (start-gate frames are not) |
| `detect.py` | vivid silk blobs in the track roi; **down-weights the brown track hue** so texture/infield is suppressed; caps to `field_size+2` largest |
| `rail.py` | fits the **inner (runner-side)** rail: per scan-line takes the white band nearest the field centroid, robust quadratic — not a global fit through all white (which lands mid-track) |
| `reid.py` | greedy motion linkage → tracklets; then **motion-anchored** stitch (keep long tracklets as identity anchors, fold only short fragments by silk colour) |
| `rail_transform.py` | px→m scale from drawn track width / rail separation; `y_lat` = perp offset×scale; `x_arclen` = field-centroid path integral anchored to race distance |
| `studies/cv_path_extraction.py` | driver: runs on the sample, writes the panel + a sanity diagnostic + figure |

driver runs synchronously: `uv run --group vision --group dev python studies/cv_path_extraction.py`.

## (2) result — the panel (one race, st 1600m)
`data_cache/cv_lateral_paths_sample.parquet`, **1,187 rows × 13 cols**, tidy
`(venue,date,race_no,runner,t,frame, x_arclen, y_lat, rail_offset_px, silk_lab_{l,a,b}, confidence)`.

| metric | value | read |
|---|---|---|
| runners recovered | 12 | matches a full field |
| `x_arclen` range | 0 → **1597 m** | recovers the **1600 m** race length (centroid integral, anchored) |
| `y_lat` | min 1.8 / **median 14.4** / max 31.9 m | spread across the track, sensible |
| `y_lat` within [0, width] | **100.0%** | track width (course a) = 30.5 m |
| arc-length monotone | **100%** of steps non-decreasing | the longitudinal axis is well-behaved |
| mean confidence | 0.93 | detection+rail+scale composite |

`y_lat` is the **new** signal this unlocks; `x_arclen` is the longitudinal axis that
**joins to `data_cache/trajectory_dataset_full.parquet`** on `(venue,date,race_no,runner)`
with `x_arclen ↔ sectional d`. (sample `runner` is currently a silk-cluster id `rid{n}`;
binding to the saddlecloth number is the gating step — see §3.)

## (3) honest quality — the re-id is the bottleneck, not the geometry
- **lateral coordinate: good.** bounded, physical, 100% on-track after fitting the *inner*
  rail per frame and rejecting infield-side detections. the early naive global rail fit
  gave `y_lat` up to 271 m (mid-track reference); the near-band fit + on-track filter
  closed it to [0,30.5]. this is the load-bearing correctness fix.
- **re-identification: weak — the real limit.** colour-only re-id at ~15 px cannot cleanly
  hold 12 identities for a full race: per-runner coverage is **7–50%** of frames and paths
  still id-swap between similar silks (visible as lane-jumps in the figure). the render's
  legend has the silk→number key every frame, but binding it needs digit ocr, which is the
  missing piece (`easyocr` is not installed — see §5).
- **detection recall: moderate.** dark/low-sat silks and the horse body (vs the silk cap)
  are missed; we kept recall clean-over-complete on purpose (a missed runner beats an
  infield false positive). mean ~7 blobs/frame for a 12-field.
- **arc-length: proxy.** centroid-integral anchored to the known distance, not the odometer
  (ocr again). monotone and right-scaled, but it is a field-level series, not per-runner —
  fine for joining, not yet for per-runner ground-lost.
- **leak-free by construction.** like form, the (d, y_lat) path is a trailing per-horse
  trait computed from the race itself; averaged over a horse's past runs and joined on
  `horse_id` it is leak-free for future races (same argument as the feasibility probe).

## (4) why it matters (research_program §1/§2/§3)
`y_lat` is the lateral path the longitudinal sectional dataset cannot see. it is the raw
material for: **ground-lost / path efficiency** (extra metres run wide on bends),
**c_da / drafting** (lateral spacing vs the runner ahead), the **jockey-control latent a**
(how a rider places the horse laterally), and **geometry×control** de-confounding. rq-ctl1/
ctl2 (control vs ground-saved) need exactly this lateral axis.

## (5) scale-up plan for the full-arc backfill
1. **number-binding (the gate).** add `easyocr` (or a tiny digit cnn) to ocr each legend
   cell's number box, build a stable silk→number map per race, and key `runner` to the
   saddlecloth number. this is the single highest-value next step; without it the panel is
   anonymous. `easyocr` is **not in the `vision` group** — propose adding it (noted, not
   installed globally).
2. **re-id robustness.** fuse the legend running-order (left→right = current order) with
   silk colour and motion → hungarian assignment under one-number-per-runner, the
   `identify.assign_runners` contract already sketched in `src/hkjc/vision/identify.py`.
3. **odometer ocr** for true per-frame `x_arclen` (replaces the centroid-integral proxy),
   enabling per-runner ground-lost.
4. **coverage.** the aerial virtual view covers the full arc (bends + straight), unlike the
   broadcast pan — so once re-id holds, coverage is a render-availability question, not a
   camera-coverage one. per-race the render exists for most cards; the corpus join is on
   `(venue,date,race_no)`.
5. **occlusion.** the pack bunches on bends; bridge gaps with the existing motion model +
   kalman/rts smoothing (the `project.build_trajectory` contract) once ids are stable.
6. **validation.** wire `export.qa`: integrate recovered speed to each sectional boundary,
   diff vs published sectionals (the kill criterion); check finish-order vs official result.

## (6) what i changed
new: `src/hkjc/vision/mode_b/{__init__,layout,detect,rail,reid,rail_transform,pipeline_b}.py`,
`studies/cv_path_extraction.py`. wrote `data_cache/cv_lateral_paths_sample.parquet` +
`data_cache/figs/cv_lateral_paths_sample.png`. the existing `src/hkjc/vision/*.py` stubs
(broadcast mode-a scaffold) are left in place — they target the side view and a different
detector path; mode b is the tractable substrate for this video. `ruff check
src/hkjc/vision studies` clean; full suite **172 passed**. `src/hkjc/model|core` untouched.

## (7) blocker
`easyocr` / a digit model is missing from the `vision` dep group; the legend number-binding
(step 1, the gate to a usable backfill) needs it. everything else (cv2/av/ultralytics/numpy)
is present. cuda is off — fine for classical mode b, but a fine-tuned detector path (mode a)
would want a gpu.

title: "S1c READ-SIDE (#69): read the FULL career θ = (CP, W'_0, P_max) from the dedicated per-surface estimators and run the EOM FORWARD to a MECHANISTIC ability index (EOM-predicted finishing mean velocity, parameter-free given θ) — does it close the gap to the 0054 oracle? VERDICT: NO. The forward-EOM full-θ index reaches ρ(rf_now) ST +0.099 / HV +0.024 — barely above the single-v_c read (+0.083/+0.020), closing only +11% / +3% of the gap to the 0054 oracle (+0.231/+0.157) and far below the form ceiling (+0.312/+0.250). Adding W'_0 over a CP-only forward EOM lifts +0.033 ST / +0.012 HV; adding P_max adds ~0. The full physiological θ does carry a LITTLE more ability than CP alone (mostly via W'), but the FORWARD EOM is itself a COLLAPSE: it maps the rich career velocity PROFILE back onto ONE scalar (the predicted mean velocity), discarding exactly the profile SHAPE (v_open vs v_mean vs v_close) that 0054 showed carries ⅔ of the path's ability signal. So reading full θ does NOT recover the oracle — the bottleneck is the single-scalar SUMMARY (whether v_c or the EOM mean velocity), not which constants are read. DECISION-RELEVANT: the win-prob propagation must consume the multi-dimensional career velocity PROFILE (or the EOM's predicted profile SHAPE, not just its mean), not a richer single index. A forward-EOM mean-velocity index is NOT the fix."

text:
"s1c read-side (#69): read the full career θ = (cp, w'_0, p_max) from the dedicated per-surface estimators and run the eom forward to a mechanistic ability index (eom-predicted finishing mean velocity, parameter-free given θ) — does it close the gap to the 0054 oracle? verdict: no. the forward-eom full-θ index reaches ρ(rf_now) st +0.099 / hv +0.024 — barely above the single-v_c read (+0.083/+0.020), closing only +11% / +3% of the gap to the 0054 oracle (+0.231/+0.157) and far below the form ceiling (+0.312/+0.250). adding w'_0 over a cp-only forward eom lifts +0.033 st / +0.012 hv; adding p_max adds ~0. the full physiological θ does carry a little more ability than cp alone (mostly via w'), but the forward eom is itself a collapse: it maps the rich career velocity profile back onto one scalar (the predicted mean velocity), discarding exactly the profile shape (v_open vs v_mean vs v_close) that 0054 showed carries ⅔ of the path's ability signal. so reading full θ does not recover the oracle — the bottleneck is the single-scalar summary (whether v_c or the eom mean velocity), not which constants are read. decision-relevant: the win-prob propagation must consume the multi-dimensional career velocity profile (or the eom's predicted profile shape, not just its mean), not a richer single index. a forward-eom mean-velocity index is not the fix." s1c read-side full-theta forward-eom eom ability-index ability-read career-aggregation empirical-bayes eb-shrink expanding-prior critical-power critical-velocity w-prime p-max pmax-opening wprime-spent sprint-ceiling dedicated-surface deconfounded-cruise hill form form-target rf-now re-emergence reemergence rating-floor form-ceiling oracle under-extracted velocity-profile scalar-collapse leak-free strictly-prior first-principles no-regression no-epicycle pure-mechanism 0048 0052 0054 s1c read-side — the critical-path fix proposed by 0054. 0054's oracle (a regularized oos ridge over
the whole strictly-prior career velocity profile) reached ρ(rf_now) st +0.231 / hv +0.157, ~2.8×/7.8×
the single-v_c fused read (+0.083/+0.020), at 74%/63% of the form ceiling — diagnosing the path as
under-extracted: the single critical-velocity collapse throws ~⅔ of the path's ability away. this
entry tests the mechanistic (non-regression) version of the proposed fix: read the full physiological
θ from the career-aggregated dedicated per-surface estimators and run the eom forward to an ability
index, and check whether it reaches the oracle. discipline: mechanism, not an epicycle — the index is
the eom-predicted finishing velocity given θ, parameter-free given θ; nothing is fit/regressed onto
form (form is a correlation target only). the oracle is the ceiling to reach, never the model.

## what was built (src/hkjc/model/pure_mechanism.py — the only file edited in src/)
1. **per-run p_max and w'_0**, added to `build_pure_mechanism_panel` (the strictly-prior panel),
   reusing the existing dedicated estimators (`hkjc.model.identify`):
   * **p_max [w]** = mean of `pmax_opening_run` (the gate-transient peak, 0048's top surface) and
     `pmax_for_ceiling(sprint_ceiling_velocity)` (the sustained-sprint cross-check). 0048 showed
     opening ≈ 2× ceiling (peak-instantaneous vs sustained); their mean is the least-aliased single
     deployment ceiling the forward eom wants, bounded to [15, 120] kw.
   * **w'_0 [j]** = `wprime_spent_run(run, cp)` with `cp` = the de-confounded cruise cp for that run
     (cp_for_cruise of the field-de-confounded settled velocity, 0049) — the reserve-spent-above-cp
     surface (0048), bounded to [10, 600] kj.
   * a per-run cruise **cp/v_c** (the de-confounded cruise velocity, already in the panel).
2. **career-eb aggregation** (`eb_shrink` + new panel columns `vc_career`/`pmax_career`/
   `wprime0_career` and their prior-run counts): for each horse, the strictly-prior expanding-window
   mean of each constant over its prior runs (the run's own path never enters its own θ), to be
   empirical-bayes-shrunk toward the train-only population mean by `n/(n+k)`, k=3 prior-run units —
   the physics analog of recency-form eb. leak-free by construction.
3. **new `studies/path_full_theta_check.py`**: assemble the eb-shrunk career full θ per run, run the
   forward eom (`dynamics.eom_section_velocities_fast`) for the run's known distance + conditions
   (mass via `body_mass_kg`, going) → the eom-predicted finishing mean velocity = the mechanistic
   ability index. correlate with the same leak-free form target as 0052/0054 (run's realised relative
   finish rf_now, both venues, aligned on the same path-based-read rows), with the single-v_c fused
   read, the 0054 oracle, the form ceiling, the rating floor.

## the table (pearson ρ; aligned path rows; st n=15,663, hv n=6,304; coverage of career θ ≈ 100% of rows)
target = the run's own realised finish rf_now (0052 table b / 0054 headline — directly comparable)
| venue | n | eom full-θ index | single-v_c (0052) | 0054 oracle | form ceiling | rating floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **st** | 15,663 | **+0.099** | +0.083 | +0.231 | +0.312 | −0.001 |
| **hv** | 6,304  | **+0.024** | +0.020 | +0.157 | +0.250 | −0.026 |

(secondary, target = strictly-prior recency-form: eom full-θ st +0.260 / hv +0.196 vs single-v_c
+0.188/+0.148 vs oracle +0.560/+0.525 vs ceiling +0.895/+0.917 — same picture: a small lift over the
single read, a long way short of the oracle.)

## marginal value of p_max and w' over a cp-only forward eom (rf_now, st / hv)
| forward-eom θ | st | hv |
|---|---|---|
| cp-only (career cp, pop p_max + w') | +0.065 | +0.014 |
| cp + w' (pop p_max) | +0.097 | +0.024 |
| cp + p_max (pop w') | +0.066 | +0.012 |
| full θ (cp + w' + p_max) | +0.099 | +0.024 |

so **w'_0 carries a real but small marginal lift** (+0.032 st / +0.010 hv over cp-only) and **p_max
carries ~0** (δ vs full ≈ +0.001 / −0.001). the full physiological θ is slightly more form-relevant
than cp alone — but the increment is tiny against the oracle gap.

## the verdict — reading full θ does not close the gap; the eom-mean collapse is the bottleneck
the forward-eom full-θ index reaches +0.099 / +0.024, **+11% / +3%** of the way from the single-v_c
read to the 0054 oracle, and roughly ⅓ of the form ceiling. it does not close the gap. the reason is
mechanistically clear and reconciles 0054 exactly:

**the forward eom is itself a scalar collapse.** 0054 localized the path's ability signal in the
multi-dimensional career velocity profile — the shape relating opening vs cruise vs closing section
speeds (top ridge weights v_open +0.37, v_mean −0.35, v_close +0.26), not any single level. the
forward-eom ability index, by design, maps the full θ back onto one number (the predicted finishing
mean velocity). that single scalar cannot carry the profile shape, so it inherits almost the same
ceiling as the single-v_c read — confirming that the bottleneck is the single-scalar summary, not
which constants feed it. reading three constants instead of one helps only insofar as w' perturbs the
mean velocity a little; it does not restore the discarded shape information.

this is the honest, decision-relevant outcome the task asked for: **the eom full-θ index does not beat
the single-v_c read by much and falls well short of the oracle.** per the task's own framing, that
means the win-prob propagation — how θ becomes a finishing-order law — is where the richer signal must
enter, not a cleverer single ability index. a forward-eom mean-velocity index is not the fix.

## what the propagation rebuild should consume (the pointer this hands to the orchestrator)
the +0.231/+0.157 oracle lives in the career velocity profile's shape. to capture it mechanistically
(no regression) the generative drift must read the profile, not a level:
- feed the eb-shrunk career θ into the eom and let the win/order law read the predicted section-
  velocity profile (the full `eom_section_velocities_fast` vector — opening ramp, cruise, closing
  kick/fade), not just its mean — the closing-vs-cruise differential is where v_close/v_mean live;
- equivalently, let the first-passage/order law be driven by the de-confounded career profile's
  shape (a multi-section drift), so the opening-vs-closing contrast that the oracle weights enters the
  win probability directly. the single drift v_c (or a single eom-mean index) provably cannot.
the path is not exhausted (0054 stands); but the missing extraction is in the propagation's use of the
profile, not in adding more constants to a scalar read.

## discipline / leak-freedom
first-principles, no regression of the outcome into the model: the ability index is the eom-predicted
finishing velocity given θ — parameter-free given θ, no fitted coefficient, no epicycle. form is a
correlation target only, never an input to any read. leak-free: every career θ is strictly-prior
(expanding prior-mean, a run's own path excluded — panel construction); the eb population means and
the v_c-only/p_max/w' contrast priors are train-only (a 60/40 time split); the form targets are
shifted one race back; the rating is an as-of backward join; mass/going are known pre-race public.
`src/hkjc/model/pure_mechanism.py` is the only src file edited (its sole editor); `dynamics.py`,
`generative.py`, the pricer, `gate.py`, `field.py`, `identify.py` untouched. lint clean
(`ruff check src/hkjc/model/pure_mechanism.py studies/path_full_theta_check.py`). the pure_mechanism
unit suite is green (5 passed) with the no-meta-signal-import guard intact (the new panel columns are
strictly-prior physiology; no meta-signal table imported). don't-bake — a read-side diagnostic; the θ
builder / production constants are unchanged (the new career columns are emitted by the panel but not
yet wired into the drift, pending the propagation decision). caveat: the index is the eom finishing
mean velocity; a propagation that reads the predicted profile (not the mean) is the untested next step
the oracle implies — this entry only falsifies the "richer single index" route, it does not test the
profile-propagation route.

title: "S1d EXPLOITATION-CEILING (decision-gating): IF we extracted the path's FULL ability signal, how much WIN-GATE skill results? Converts each of three strictly-prior leak-free ability ESTIMATES to a single-feature ConditionalLogit win model and scores exact %-of-market on the WIN gate, common support (horses with prior history), both venues. VERDICT: the path-ability CEILING converts to only ST 27% / HV 32% of market — a real LIFT over the current scalar v_c read (ST 14% / HV 27%; +13pts / +5pts, the 0054 read-fix is worth ~half the gap at ST, almost nothing at HV) but FAR below the ACTUAL recency-form upper bound (ST 60% / HV 45%) and far below the deleted model's 65%/60%.
